title: DAY 22/90
VIBRATIONS
scenes.sub: Push a system at the wrong speed and it shakes apart
scenes.voice: Day twenty two of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge, eighty six days left! Today we force the vibration, and learn why resonance can wreck a machine.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Today's subject is Vibrations. Our topic: forced vibration, a steady scorer in GATE M. E. numericals.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover the forced response and resonance, the magnification factor, vibration isolation and transmissibility, and the critical or whirling speed of shafts.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
lines: At r = √2, TR = 1; above it, damping raises TR
scenes.voice: Quick tip. Isolation works only when the frequency ratio is above root two. At exactly root two, transmissibility is one for any damping, and beyond it, more damping actually hurts.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
